main.description: Public metadata for a patient referral (紹介状). The referral letter body is held inside com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record envelope; this record only indexes the routing tuple (fromFacilityDid, toFacilityDid, specialty, urgency, status) so external facilities can discover pending inbox items without read-cap.

patientDidHash.description: salted hash of patient DID (NOT plaintext patient DID; correlation-resistant)

encryptedLetterCid.description: CID of encrypted referral letter inside com.etzhayyim.encrypted.record
